query:
SELECT l.code, l.name, COUNT(les.id) as lesson_count 
FROM languages l 
LEFT JOIN courses c ON c.languageId = l.id 
LEFT JOIN lessons les ON les.courseId = c.id 
GROUP BY l.code, l.name 
ORDER BY lesson_count DESC 
LIMIT 20
